question: Does a frozen prior-execution filter connect the improved fixed capability to public choice, and does it survive one predeclared clearance change?
seed_scope: Retained difficult execution seed 96162 plus fresh 96167; one inspected source/corridor, no ancestry holdout
comparators: Same four immutable motions, motor, initial state, scene information, goal, timing, native packing and score. Old geometry/cost selector, prior-evidence filter, fixed lowered control.
changed_geometry: Translate only beam center Z by -0.020 m in the task, scoring gate and USD. Floor bytes/goal/reset unchanged.
qualification: At least two designated prior attempts and zero failures per clear/beam context; no new outcomes used. Lowered beam has 3/3 original-beam calibration only.
outcome: Unchanged complete passage/duck/recovery/goal/fresh 50-tick hold/contact/fall score, 500 control ticks. Contact is any forbidden measured force >1N.
rejection: No qualified candidate is a request rejection before action, not success, physical impossibility or a qualified safe stop. All registered cases are expected to pass the existing geometric screen.
analysis: All attempts, paired gains/regressions, selected candidates, false admissions (selected but task fails), raw contact cause, exact initial state/dynamics, reference/token/action replay and matched fixed executor. Changed clearance is extrapolation.
decision: If original capability transfers to public selection but lower20 fails even fixed, prioritize capability/clearance coverage before online composition or training. If public differs from selected fixed, repair interface first.
retry: No scientific tuning/retry. Preserve infrastructure failures; one isolated repair retry maximum per affected condition.
